subject: bio
title: Biological Molecules
subtitle: Biological Molecules with mechanism-focused explanation and exam-linked examples.
concept: Biological molecules are built from recurring chemical units whose structure determines function. Small differences in bond type or side groups can create major biological effects.
Macromolecules form through condensation reactions and break down by hydrolysis. These reversible processes underpin digestion, synthesis, and metabolism.
In exams, high-scoring answers compare molecules in terms of structure, solubility, energy role, and functional significance in cells.
